Anna ordered chicken and juice at the city square last night. On Wednesday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Ticket stubs count as memorabilia too.

Anna thanked Lily for the honest advice. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The riverside walk looked quieter than usual that evening. In fact, glass skyscrapers line the new district.

People around Anna often share different ideas about the riverside walk. Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Anna keeps a small panda at home and feeds it every morning. The sample sale queues from dawn.
Lily advised Anna to try drawing as a new hobby. Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. He is a careful spender who tracks every dollar.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.
